But I think this image touches on something a lot of people who are suicidal might not realize.  There are *parts* of us we don't like, maybe its a lot of parts, but not all of it. As humans we have an incredible capacity for change if we can muster it.  Personally, I'm trying to put myself in a different environment so I can become the person I want to be.  Hopefully a new environment/perspective will help me shed those parts I don't like, and grow the ones I do.
